channel.title: Zambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Zambia, every source cited.

item.title: Mandevu by-election candidate withdraws citing threats
item.description: Forum for Democracy and Development candidate Daniel Chisenga pulled out of the race for the Mandevu seat.

item.title: Zambia starts cholera vaccine plant construction next month
item.description: The facility at Lusaka South Multi Facility Economic Zone will produce 20 million doses annually.

item.title: Zambian president directs halt to plot allocations without infrastructure
item.description: President Hichilema tasks Housing Minister Christopher Kalila to address the 1.5 million housing deficit and enforce planning standards.

item.title: Court nullifies UPND Mapatizya seat
item.description: High Court Judge Kazimbe Chenda ruled the election of Emelda Munashabantu premature due to tallying irregularities.

item.title: First Lady receives 200 hospital beds
item.description: Donation from Chinese Chamber of Commerce aims to improve maternal health delivery in Zambia.
